concept: S3 security: Block Public Access + AWS Config rules
tests: How to prevent and continuously detect public S3 buckets and evaluate configurations against best practices (choose two).
expected: Account-level S3 Block Public Access (prevention) + AWS Config rules (continuous evaluation and detection of non-compliant buckets). Triggers: "publicly accessible buckets", "continuously evaluate configurations".
why_not: Cost Explorer — billing; CloudFront access logs — delivery analytics, not a security control.
